sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Singapore

sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea

sources.supportingExcerpt: 招待状を受けていればトルクメニスタンの空港で査証を取得しトルクメニスタンに入国できます

policies.title: Singaporean ordinary passports: Turkmenistan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Singapore’s current Foreign Ministry guidance directly requires Singaporeans to obtain a Turkmen visa before travel and separately requires ordinary Singapore passport holders to obtain a local-entity invitation before travelling.
conditions: Applies to a Singaporean travelling on an ordinary passport for a short visit.
Obtain the visa and a letter of invitation from a qualifying local entity before travel; the guidance identifies the Turkmen Embassy in Seoul as the relevant contact.
Purpose-specific invitation requirements, work, residence, special documents, registration, restricted areas and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: South Korean ordinary passports: Turkmenistan airport arrival visa
policies.summary: Korea’s current Foreign Ministry guidance directly says ordinary passports are not visa-free and that the Turkmen visa is affixed at the airport when the traveller carries the required Migration-approved official invitation.
conditions: Applies to a South Korean citizen travelling on an ordinary passport for a short visit.
Before travel, obtain an official invitation approved by the State Migration Service; the guidance warns that boarding is unavailable without it.

The visa itself is affixed on arrival at a Turkmen airport. Tourist invitations are requested through a local travel agency; land-border issuance, work, residence, special documents, restricted areas and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: Turkmenistan airport arrival visa
policies.summary: Turkmenistan’s current Embassy in Japan guidance directly says a traveller holding the required Migration invitation may obtain the visa at a Turkmen airport and enter.
conditions: Applies to a Japanese citizen travelling on an ordinary passport for a short visit under the Japan-specific mission process.
Before travel, obtain an invitation issued through the State Migration Service; tourists apply through a qualifying travel company and carriers may require the invitation before boarding.
The visa itself is issued at a Turkmen airport. Land-border issuance, work, residence, special documents, restricted areas and final admission remain outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback treats the route as advance-issued, while current Korean MFA guidance directly says the visa is affixed at a Turkmen airport after the mandatory Migration-approved invitation.
The fallback treats the route as advance-issued, while the current Turkmen Embassy in Japan states that a traveller holding the required Migration invitation can obtain the visa at a Turkmen airport.
